next_action: Do not apply local truncated resultants independently. Construct one genuinely shared transposed multi-target valuation-and-marker operator for the occurrence divisor. It must process the complete B^(5/4) target stream after B^(9/4) setup without a B^(9/4) factor per target, emit exact integer counts and B^(3/4) A/C marginals, and replay R144 rank, factor logs, and shifted descent. It may use no DLP, root, resultant, valuation, count, marginal, rank, or source oracle.
objective: Determine whether replacing dense squarefree gcd traces by local valuations of a repeated occurrence pair-resultant meets the source-equivalent R146 count-and-marginal caps.

theorem.finite_actual_result: Every sampled positive and empty target on all eight actual controls has local pair-resultant valuation equal to its direct ordered C6 count.

occurrence_divisor.definition: P_occ(X)=product over ordered C3 occurrences (X-cayley_parameter(sum occurrence)); repeated endpoints remain repeated roots.

pair_resultant.definition: R(T)=product over ordered C3 occurrence pairs (T-(x oplus y)), up to nonzero Cayley chart units.
pair_resultant.local_count_identity: ord_(T=tau) R(T) equals the ordered C6 fiber count when every local Cayley factor is simple in T.

theorem.scope: This charges componentwise or direct-product applications of the bound truncated-resultant algorithm to the occurrence divisor. It is not a lower bound for shared transposed multi-target circuits, modular-composition data structures, RAM, or cell probes.

standard_truncated_resultant_cost.paper_bound: Moroz-Schost computes a degree-d bivariate resultant truncated to order k in soft-O(d*k) base-field operations, including singular expansion points under its characteristic hypothesis.
standard_truncated_resultant_cost.paper_characteristic_condition: characteristic zero or at least the truncation order k
